methodology.chain: Exactly one call per actual Node/Sites parser for each stored observation. No runDocumentProcess, worker, rasterizer or Tesseract call. Text, method, confidence, input hash and word evidence are supplied unchanged.
methodology.population: Eight readable synthetic normal images and two separate stress images from the known V1 corpus. These images and observations have already been used in diagnosis.
methodology.metrics: The unchanged helper measures all 13 fields, mandatory 10 and mandatory image-only 9 separately for each engine. Wrong non-null values count as FP and FN; null known values remain FN. Stress is separate.
methodology.metadata: Direction supplier remains supplied metadata, not image recovery. Image-only nine excludes direction.
methodology.timing: durationMs in new details and summaries measures parsing only. reusedProcessing.processingTimeMs is historical optical timing and is never included as new processing work.
methodology.limits: Not a fresh optical run, independent holdout, browser/cloud end-to-end test, production validation or financial approval. Numeric targets do not establish general-population accuracy.
